events.title: London's 90% partial solar eclipse
events.summary: The eclipse begins at 6.17pm, reaches roughly 90% coverage at 7.12pm and ends at 8.06pm. Use certified eclipse glasses or watch the Observatory's free stream.

events.title: Roman London Family Quest
events.venue: Roman Amphitheatre, London Museum and London Mithraeum
events.summary: A free family trail joins three Roman-London sites from 10am to 4pm on Friday and Saturday. It is aimed at ages 5–11, open to all and does not require booking.

events.title: Charing Cross and Waterloo East station closure
events.location: London Charing Cross and London Waterloo East
events.summary: No trains serve either station during a 22-day, £20m engineering programme. Southeastern routes divert to other London terminals and weekend arrangements can vary.

events.title: The Pirates of Penzance at Kenwood
events.summary: Illyria's outdoor Gilbert and Sullivan performance runs from 7pm to 9pm. Doors open at 6pm; adult tickets are £20 and child tickets are £10.

events.title: The Sword in the Stone at Keats House
events.summary: The family-friendly outdoor show runs from 6pm to 8pm. Tickets start at £17 and visitors should bring a blanket, rug or low-backed chair.

events.title: AI in Healthcare late-registration deadline
events.summary: Late registration closes for the 26–28 August conference. Full access is £620, student access £480 and single-day tickets £250.

events.title: UCL Hatchery incubator application deadline
events.summary: Applications close at 11.59pm for UCL's two-year, equity-free incubator. Applicants must be current UCL students or recent graduates and have a registered company.

events.title: London 6G Week
events.summary: A week of standards, communications and AI-native network sessions culminates in the one6G Summit on 10–11 September; registration is open.
